evidence: The verify.txt shows CMD_UNKNOWN (npm run dev) and PATH_MISSING (.sqlite, src/server.js, config/default.json) findings, but AGENTS.md explicitly negates all of them: 'The README previously described a different codebase shape (npm run dev, port 3000, src/server.js, config/default.json) — none of those exist' (line 80) and 'Don't go hunting for a .sqlite file; there isn't one yet' (line 58), so they fall under the exception for negations and do not count as failures.
